in_hebrew.name: Osmund
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Osmund הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English ōsmund, composed of os (wealth) and mund (protection). Osmund was a popular Old English name that was adopted into Latin as Osmundus.

in_greek.name: Osmund
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Wealthy protection
in_greek.long_meaning: Osmund είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old English ōsmund, composed of os (wealth) and mund (protection). Osmund was a popular Old English name that was adopted into Latin as Osmundus.

in_latin.name: Osmundus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Old High German elements 'os' (god) and 'mund' (protection).
